1.
Heard Mr. S Ali, learned counsel for the petitioners.

Also heard Mr. Page No.# 3/4 BB Gogoi,
learned Addl. PP, appearing for the State respondent.

2. The petitioners, namely, 1. Samir Ali 2. Abjan Bibi, 3. Amjed Ali Page No.# 1/4 vs The State Of Assam on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/93655806/
2

4 . Ajad Ali, 5. Rofik Ali, 6. Anuwar Ali, 7. Asmina Bibi, 8. Rupa Bibi and 9. Hasina Bibi, have filed an application under section 438 Cr.P.C., for grant of pre arrest bail in connection with Palashbari PS Case No.95/2023 under sections 419/376/325 IPC.
3.
It is submitted on behalf of the petitioners that there was a love affair between the petitioner No.6. Anuwar Ali and the informant.
It is also submitted at the bar that a false case has been launched against the petitioners.

It has been speculated that Anuwar Ali is engaged to another girl,
which is not true.
It is also submitted that the victim went to the petitioners' house and hurled abuses and she had this suspicion that Anowar Ali is engaged to another girl.

4. The FIR unfolds that both the petitioner No.6 and the victim had a love affair and the petitioner promised to marry the victim and induced her into having physical relationship with false promises of marriage.
5. It is submitted at the bar that all the petitioners have been falsely roped in connection with this case.
No offence under section 376 IPC lies against the petitioners.
It is submitted that the other sections are bailable.
6. To consider the bail application, case diary is necessary.

7. Call for the case diary along with the injury report, fixing the matter on 05.04.2023.
8.

Meanwhile, in the interim and in the event of arrest of the petitioners 1. Samir Ali 2. Abjan Bibi, 3.
Amjed Ali 4. Ajad Ali, 5.
Page No.# 4/4 Rofik Ali, 7. Asmina Bibi, 8. Rupa Bibi and 9. Hasina Bibi, the petitioners shall be enlarged on bail of Rs.50,000/- each with a suitable surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority subject to the condition that:
i.

The petitioners will appear before the IO within 10 days and cooperate with the investigation;
ii. the petitioners will not exercise threats to the witnesses;
9. The prayer of the petitioner No.6 will be considered after perusal of the case diary.
10. List accordingly.
